critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.twilio_status correctly gates on ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN, reads TWILIO_* from env, and returns masked SIDs via _mask (safe — first 6 chars + last 4). Good.

admin_routes.twilio_logs limits to last 100 docs via find({}).sort(created_at,-1).limit(100).to_list(100) — good pagination default; consider adding ?limit and ?since query params for larger deployments.
otp_attempts collection has no TTL index — logs accumulate indefinitely. Recommend TTL index on created_at (e.g., 90 days) so /twilio/logs and otps_all_time don't grow unbounded.

otps_last_24h uses ISO string comparison ({'$gt': since_iso}); works because ISO-8601 UTC is lexicographically ordered, but a proper Date field + BSON date query would be more idiomatic and index-friendly.
_mask returns '{first6}…{last4}' — uses non-ASCII ellipsis (\u2026). Fine for JSON but ensure frontend renders it (React does by default).

auth_routes.send_otp inserts otp_attempts AFTER Twilio's send_otp() succeeds — if Twilio raises, the counter/logs won't reflect the attempted send. That may be desired (only log successful sends) but consider a separate 'attempts' vs 'successes' collection for observability.
No rate limit on /admin/twilio/logs; a compromised super_admin token could tail all OTP history. Fine for MVP but consider audit-logging /twilio/logs reads.
